LESSON: USE OF SOCIAL MEDIA

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Morality and Social Media
Topic 6.1: Use of Social Media

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Use of Social Media
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why should you use social media appropriately?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. discuss appropriate ways of using social media
2. apply the value of integrity when using social media

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: discuss appropriate ways of using social media

Teach
• Today’s focus: discuss appropriate ways of using social media.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “discuss appropriate ways of using social media” using a school example.
• Model B for “discuss appropriate ways of using social media” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "discuss appropriate ways of using social media" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 2: apply the value of integrity when using social media

Teach
• Today’s focus: apply the value of integrity when using social media.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “apply the value of integrity when using social media” using a school example.
• Model B for “apply the value of integrity when using social media” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "apply the value of integrity when using social media" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: discuss appropriate ways of using social media
• Model 2: apply the value of integrity when using social media

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: discuss appropriate ways of using social media
2. Practise: apply the value of integrity when using social media

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Use of Social Media.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why should you use social media appropriately?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• discuss appropriate ways of using social media
• apply the value of integrity when using social media

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
